unreachable.why: No dataset in the NYC Open Data catalog reports free curb spaces or garage occupancy. The city publishes meter locations, rate zones and tickets (all profiled or listed here), but not real-time availability.
Not found in the catalog; only meter locations and block faces are published.

MTA GTFS-realtime feeds are reachable but change every few seconds; a static dashboard cannot show them. A small back end could add them later.
